name: Great China Metal Ind. Co., Ltd.
summary: Great China Metal Ind. Co., Ltd., established in 1973 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, operates as a prominent international manufacturer and supplier of a wide array of packaging solutions, primarily serving the food and beverage sectors. The company's product portfolio is extensive, covering various metal containers. They produce aluminum cans designed for an assortment of carbonated beverages, beers, juices, coffee, tea, and sports drinks, including aluminum pop cans and their corresponding lids. Their steel can offerings cater to products such as juice, coffee, tea, dairy items, sports drinks, congee, and desserts. Additionally, Great China Metal manufactures essential components like top and bottom ends for both beverage and food cans, along with DRD (Drawn and Redrawn) cans. Beyond rigid containers, the company is a significant producer of stretch films. These include machine, handmade, paperless tube, colored, and small slitting films, all vital for packaging goods during transportation. Their applications span diverse fields such as beverage distribution, chemical raw materials, printing, textile production, electronics, automotive parts, decorative panels, can manufacturing, and warehouse logistics. Their comprehensive range also features general-purpose artistic and sanitary cans, aluminum and tinplate can ends, preforms, and plastic closures. The company further specializes in OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) and ODM (Original Design Manufacturer) services for steel containers, crafting bespoke cans for products like milk, pork floss, cookies, dried fruits, candies, tea, jam, engine oil, cream, and custom gift boxes. In addition to its manufacturing prowess, Great China Metal Ind. Co., Ltd. provides printing services for metal and metal containers. The firm also develops and sells other plastic products, packaging machinery, and engages in investment activities. Its diverse clientele includes businesses across the food, beverage, electronics, and general packaging industries.
